content.title: Expand one alert inline without turning the panel into a modal
content.test_md_blob:
# Expand one alert inline without turning the panel into a modal

> Prove that selecting an alert reveals its detail inline within the alerts list and preserves the list as a non-modal surface.

## Step 1

Open {{start_url}} in a browser and land on the portfolio dashboard page that contains the Alerts panel.

## Step 2

In the Alerts panel, confirm the alert titled "Technology concentration above target" is shown in its default collapsed state.

## Step 3

In the Alerts panel, store the current state of the alert titled "Technology concentration above target" as baseline_alert_state while it is collapsed.

## Step 4

In the Alerts panel, open the alert titled "Technology concentration above target".

## Step 5

Assert the selected alert's detail is shown within the Alerts panel inline, exactly one alert is expanded, and no modal dialog is presented for the alert list.

## Step 6 — assert @verifies ac-99, ac-100, ac-102, ac-114

Confirm state-transition check: expanded inline (equals) — the stated promise: Activating an alert expands that alert inline.
